title_en: Great Poems and Songs (18/20): Ms. Li on Old Poems and New Songs
note_en: 不仅……还…… means "not only... but also...": 她希望学生们不仅会唱歌，还能读懂古诗 "she hoped her students would not only be able to sing, but also understand classical poems." Unlike English, the second half needs no word for "but"; 还, 也 or 而且 is placed right before the second verb. Note too that 不仅 comes after the subject (学生们不仅…), not at the start of the sentence as "not only" often does in English.

That's exactly the kind of "hidden trace of classical poetry" Ms. Li was talking about.
